name: GeminiClaude
description: Offer Gemini models (Antigravity CLI, agy) alongside Claude subagents

managerSession.title: Manage Gemini agents from a Haiku session
managerSession.description: Delegate calls lock the chat, so Claude opens a separate Haiku session that runs the Gemini agents and reports back. Turn off to call delegate in the main chat.

askOnSpawn.title: Ask Claude or Gemini on each subagent
askOnSpawn.description: Before a Claude subagent starts, ask whether to run it on a Gemini model instead

autoHaiku.title: Run trivial subagents on Haiku
autoHaiku.description: Before a Claude subagent starts, judge its brief and run a trivial one (a lookup, a search, a small edit) on Haiku, without asking. A model Claude names is kept.
